uncited: **Inputs:** Unstructured-grid data set (nodes with 3D coordinates and scalar values, and elements defined by nodes); number of processors $p$; current viewing position.
**Exterior Faces:** Faces not shared by any elements.
*   **Globally exterior:** Boundary of the whole volume.
**Visible Exterior Faces:** A subset of exterior faces determined by the viewing position.
*   **Time Complexity:** Dominated by local ray-casting, which is linear in the number of samples per ray and the number of rays.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Each processor stores its partition of the data and the hds.
Memory usage is proportional to the local data size.
